help:
I answer questions from the {workspace} knowledge base, citing the pages I used.

In a private chat, just ask. In a group, mention me or reply to one of my answers.

Under each answer: 👍 or 👎 to rate it, and 💾 Save to turn the conversation into a page draft or a glossary term (editors).

/new — start a new conversation
/unlink — disconnect your account
/bind — answer in this group (workspace admins)
/unbind — stop answering in this group (workspace admins)
/help — this message

link.required: Link your account first: open the link below while signed in to {workspace}. It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
link.inGroup: You need to link your account before I can answer. Message me privately to do that.
link.success: Linked. Your questions here now run as {user}, with exactly the access you have in {workspace}.
link.unlinked: Disconnected. I will not answer this account until it is linked again.
link.notLinked: This account is not linked to anyone.

answer.failed: I could not answer that — the request to the model failed. Ask again in a moment.
answer.timeout: This answer never arrived: it took too long, or the server restarted. Ask again.
answer.noAccess: Your account no longer has access to {workspace}, so I cannot answer.
answer.disabled: The assistant is switched off for {workspace}.
answer.budget: You have used this month's AI budget in {workspace}.
answer.rateLimited: Too many questions at once — wait a minute and ask again.
answer.empty: Ask me something after the mention.

conversation.new: Started a new conversation. Earlier questions will not be taken into account.

bind.done: I will answer here when mentioned. A workspace admin can change that in Settings → Chat bots.
bind.removed: I will no longer answer in this group.
bind.forbidden: Only a workspace admin with a linked account can do that.

feedback.askReason: What was wrong with it? Pick a reason below.
feedback.linkFirst: Link your account first — message me privately.
feedback.gone: That answer is no longer available to rate.
feedback.failed: Your vote did not go through. Try again.

capture.forbidden: Only an editor of {workspace} with a linked account can save this.
capture.draftingPage: Drafting a page from this conversation…
capture.draftingTerm: Looking for the term this conversation defines…
capture.pageReady: Drafted “{title}” for review. Nothing is published until the merge request is merged.
capture.termReady: Proposed “{term}” for the glossary. It stays switched off until an editor turns it on.
capture.noTerm: I found no term in this conversation that the glossary does not already have.
capture.nothing: There is nothing in this conversation I can save.
capture.noProject: {workspace} has no project to save into.
capture.disabled: That AI agent is switched off in {workspace}.
capture.failed: Saving did not work. Press Save to try again.
capture.timeout: This draft never arrived: it took too long, or the server restarted. Press Save to try again.
capture.mrDescription: Drafted from a conversation with the {platform} chat bot. Check it against the pages it links before merging — nothing is published until then.
